answer_1.quote: We adopt a BART-based generative framework for both vision-language pre-training and downstream MABSA tasks... We formulate the outputs of the three subtasks as index generation tasks...
answer_1.outputs: Generated index sequences for aspect spans, sentiment labels, and aspect-opinion pairs

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model over three subtasks of MABSA and adopt Micro-F1 score (F1), Precision (P) and Recall (R) as the evaluation metrics... For MASC, we also use Accuracy (Acc).
